children: Inflection Point Acquisition Corp. VII announced a business combination with Elroy Air and will rename to Elroy Air, Inc., and presented an investor analyst day with an investor presentation.
Entered a Business Combination Agreement to merge Merger Sub into Elroy Air; post-close Inflection Point will be renamed Elroy Air.
Filed a draft Form S-4 confidentially and will file a registration statement including a proxy statement/prospectus for shareholder vote.
Elroy Air held a virtual analyst day Sept 21, 2026; investor presentation furnished as Exhibit 99.1.
Presentation details product, pipeline (1,410-unit conditional pipeline) and go-to-market, plus eIPP flights and a ~$46M Phase III Army contract.
Disclosed forward-looking risks including regulatory approvals, conversion of pipeline to binding orders, production ramp and financing uncertainties.
